# ClearAllExams.in

> Independent online platform (formerly NISMExams.in) for NISM certification exam preparation: mock tests, chapter-wise video lectures, revision notes and explained Q&A for 28+ NISM Series modules. Not affiliated with SEBI or NISM. Plans: Rs 599 (15 days) and Rs 699 (30 days) for most modules; a few modules such as Series XIII and V-D are priced higher. Free demo tests need no login.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.clearallexams.in/): all NISM courses, pricing, FAQs
- [NISM mock tests](https://www.clearallexams.in/nism-exams-mock-tests): free demo tests
- [FAQs](https://www.clearallexams.in/nism-exams-mock-test-faqs)
- [Testimonials](https://www.clearallexams.in/nism-exams-mock-test-testimonials)
- [Blog](https://www.clearallexams.in/nism-exams-mock-test-blogs)
- [About us](https://www.clearallexams.in/about-us)
